content: Jesús jpa̱jada riy daraju̱ñijyate vu̱yaju̱y vaduy

Rivasiy ji̱ta sabayada Nutyityu̱ riy tavay nijya̱nvay, daraju̱ñijyate vu̱yaju̱y nijya̱mi̱, danu̱ju̱y rinchaju̱. Su̱pa̱jada ji̱ta yajiju̱ nu̱ñi danu̱ju̱myusiryi nijya̱nvay, vicha̱damuju̱, vichajomuju̱ jarye ti̱ta̱ju̱ jasityi sa̱jto̱nuve.
Su̱teda ji̱ta Jesús variy ruuva: “Jasinryi rajuuvay nijya̱nvay caravye jatojadaju̱, jatóvay ji̱ta ne rajuuvay. Ramuni̱ jirya̱jachiñu̱y siva jatojadaja̱mi̱, sa̱tidye jpa̱ riy jvaavye jatojadana̱cho̱.
Jirya̱numa jiya. Ri̱pa̱ ji̱ta jirye nu̱tyu ra̱si̱midyera, jmyiryajuu cabyimuju̱.
Ne jirya̱jtu yimu tara, ne vinu criquichuy, dantyamu̱y ne dusuuy, dantyamu̱y ne saapatu. Dantyamu̱y ne jirya̱riche mu̱chuvatyityiyada nú̱va.
Jirya̱numatiy jañuve ti̱ rorimyu, jirya̱jtay munatya ruuva: ¡Samirya jirye̱cha jiryorimyu!
Saryityi vichasara rorijya̱mi̱ samirya jachityi̱, raryime̱cho̱ samirya jiryeñiquejada variy saju̱; netimyu̱ ne saryicha samirya jachityi̱, rá̱ta̱ryá jiryeñiquejada variy yimuju̱ntiy.

Jirya̱ma̱cho̱nuve variy jasiy rorimyu, jasityi jirya̱jto̱. Jirya̱ma̱ jmyi, jirya̱ma̱ jatura ratiy rirya̱muti jirye, tapi sava̱tasara Ju̱denuju̱ ju̱vaañu daryaju̱ra jimyurichenusa̱da. Ne jirya̱ja̱tay rorimyusiy, ratarya rorimyuju̱.
Jirya̱numatiy jañuve vicha̱damu, rirya̱numatiy dirye jirye, jirya̱ma̱ jmyirya ratiy rirya̱sa̱y jasiy jirye.
Jirya̱ma̱ mi̱saniryi jdiva̱jnuvay jasiy vichavay, jirya̱jtay variy ruuva: Ratuudiñuma Ju̱denu nusu̱yada jirye.

Jirya̱numatiy jañuve vicha̱damu jasityimyu̱ ne rirya̱diryeru̱y jirye, jirya̱jtay vijyo̱mujache riñijyu̱: Jiryevyichajojuru ji̱ta nu̱ña̱pu̱y jiñumutuvasiy jiryeñijyu̱: jirya̱ntya datya si̱tenu variy, jiryatiy ratuudiya̱numa Ju̱denu nusu̱yada jirye.
Ri̱tatye ji̱ta jiryiva: Jachi̱ntyava̱ju̱ day ra̱cha Sodóma ja̱nvajyu̱ Ju̱denu paruta̱da rundamu, jasiy vicha̱da ja̱nvamyusiy, jiryatimyu̱ ne ridyiryeru̱yada jasiy jirye.”
Vicha̱daja̱nvay tuva̱chu̱sa̱minchiy

“¡Acuu jiryeñijyu̱ Curasí̱ ja̱nvay! ¡Acuu jiryeñijyu̱ Betsáyina ja̱nvay! tapi raryitiy jvaayada Tíru ja̱nvay cabyimura rivaayada ti̱ttasara, nu̱tyu jiryequebyimutiy rivaayasiy daryantiy, ta̱riñuma riryi paru̱yada riva va̱cha vicha̱da, riryi dityadoda varirya jiñuvaya̱da riva jiryatiy riryimya̱sa varivyunujay sujatyavay pupujurunube. Sitú̱ ja̱nvay jarye raryi jvaayada daryantidye.
Jachi̱ntya̱da ra̱cha rijyu̱ Tíru ja̱nvay, Sitú̱ ja̱nvay jarye jiryimusiy, juuchuveda murichenutadeda rundamu.
¿Va̱ jiryeque, Capernavú̱ ja̱nvay? jiryi̱tay vidye jirye̱cha jasuminichavay jarichumuju̱ day. Jiryedye day ra̱chava̱ jmusanichavay jiidatyo̱muju̱ cay.”

Su̱teda ji̱ta Jesús yisa̱ datyavavya varintyi: “Ni̱tiy tuva̱chu jiryimu, daryaday satuva̱chu variy rimuntidye; jiñu ji̱ta jiryatiy sani rrachu jirye, daryaday sani rrachu varintyidyerye. Ni̱tiy rrachu ray, daryaday sani rrachu varintyidyeñi̱ jiryatiy su̱pa̱jada ray.”
Daraju̱ñijyate vu̱yaju̱y jpa̱savay ta̱rya̱jadanchiy

Ritye̱rya̱da ji̱ta sansu̱vye yichana̱yadamu, jiryatiy su̱pa̱jada riy daraju̱ñijyate vu̱yaju̱y vaduy, danu̱ju̱y rinchaju̱. Rityu̱chunuvi̱jada ji̱ta siva Jesús: “¡Bayantuveda jarye ji̱ta tuva̱chunu̱chiy yityamu nu̱dyimu, Nutyityu̱!”
Su̱teda ji̱ta Jesús variy ruuva: “Ri̱nu̱chusiñi̱ Satanásiy, jiryatiy saju̱u̱jechiy nu̱tyu ra̱duya̱ra jarichuvimusiy.
Jirya̱jnu̱y, rache̱mya̱ jiryerya jirya̱tidye raniye̱ rincha codimyi, norityumincha jarye, vu̱myityasiy vanu̱yadancha jarye ti̱ta̱ju̱. Ne ra̱jarupanu tara variy jirye, mitya.
Dañumamu̱y ne jiryi̱chana̱chara ramusiy jiryatiy richabuy bayantuveda jiryejyu̱. Jirya̱ma̱ jchana̱chara ji̱ta jiryatiy nu̱charanuma jiryi̱tya jarichumu.”
Jesús jchana̱tya̱dani̱ jijye̱

Varidyenuma ji̱ta si̱chana̱yada Jesús Ju̱denu Jnutumu, su̱teda ji̱ta variy: “Ri̱chana̱tyate ji, Ye̱ye̱, jarichu Nutyityu̱, jiryatiy mucadi Nutyityu̱ jarye risa̱ju̱ ji, jiryatiy jidyutya̱dara jirya datya̱da rirya̱jisiy mityamusiy datyavay, datya̱da jachityavay jarye. Jidyityadoda ji̱ta datyi̱sa̱mimyura. Jo, Ye̱ye̱, jiryatiy samiy jvadichara jidyiya darya.

Sasa̱mya̱ ji̱ta rajye̱ ti̱ta̱ju̱ ray. Ne ti̱ datya chi̱ra sani̱cha sadenu, chi̱, vinu rajye̱ datya, dantyamu̱y ne ti̱ datya chi̱ra sani̱cha rajye̱, chi̱, vinu sadenu datya, ni̱ jarye jiryatiy radyityanuru̱ñi̱.”
Sa̱numityejada ji̱ta variy yisa̱ datyavañe̱cho̱, su̱teda vinu ruuva: “¡Ju̱denu jmu̱tyasavay ji̱ta riy rityi ra̱diy riva rivatiy jiryedyi!

Ri̱tay daryaju̱ jiryiva: Rajuu Ju̱denuju̱ tu̱chuvabe, ja̱mu nutyityu̱mibe jarye, riñi diryu̱yada riva jiryatiy jiryedyi diye riva, tama̱ ridyiyada riva, tama̱; daryantya riñi tuva̱churu̱yadantidyerya jiryatiy jiryetyuva̱chura, tama̱ rityuva̱chodanu̱darya, tama̱, mitya.”
Jesús tu̱choda Samáriya ja̱mi̱nchiy, jiryatiy jaryi jantyutyarani̱
Sanubeseda ji̱ta niquejada datyi̱, sa̱tidye jantya variy saniy Jesús. Sitaja̱doda ji̱tani̱: “¿Datyanu̱, ta̱ra jvaayadiva ra̱jmutya̱ra rayaru̱rya ju̱na̱reju̱ jnu̱yadamu, ta̱ra?”
Su̱mutya̱jada ji̱ta Jesús variñi̱: “¿Ta̱ra ranique Ju̱denu niquejada, ta̱ra? ¿Nu̱tyura jiñiquettara, nu̱tyura?”

Su̱mutya̱jada ji̱ta niquejada datyi̱ni̱ Jesús: “Vurya̱ma̱ va̱tasara ti̱ta̱ju̱ vu̱jechityani̱ Vu̱ntyityu̱ Ju̱denu, ti̱ta̱ju̱ vuryi̱ntuta jarye, ti̱ta̱ju̱ vu̱vyanu̱yadata jarye, ti̱ta̱ju̱ vu̱jechipiya̱jadata jarye risa̱ju̱. Vurya̱ma̱ va̱tasarani̱ vu̱tyuunu vichi̱ntidye, nu̱tyu vu̱vya̱tasaratiy daryantidyevyu̱y.”
Su̱teda ji̱ta Jesús variy siva: “Yimutya̱jasiy vase. Ya̱jvaay daryacu̱, ya̱tidye jnu̱jeya̱sara variy.”
Ni̱ni̱ ji̱ta jiryatiy sani̱charu̱y samirya jvadichi̱ variy nijya̱nvay diya, su̱teda ju̱na̱y variy siva Jesús: “¿Chi̱ra sani̱chate ratyuunuvichi̱ day, chi̱?”

Su̱mutya̱jada ji̱ta Jesús variy tu̱chodatani̱: “Savichanu̱yada ti̱qui vanu, su̱musa̱da ji̱ta Jerusarí̱musiy Jericó na̱cho̱ju̱. Saya̱damu, yito̱jada vase paranu̱nuvay jomuju̱. Richipyata̱da sivasirya jichujay, rimyusiye̱yada variñi̱, rityocheda vadiiryo̱de variy jasiñi̱.
Ta̱ripyudemusiy ji̱ta, sani ramiryi̱jada ti̱qui caserdóte nú̱va varintyi; sadiyadanumatiy siva vadiiryo̱, sanumutatyityiyada variy sa̱jisiy.
Daryaday sito̱jada ti̱qui Ju̱denu rorimyu ju̱vaañu simu vadiiryo̱ jityiryo̱jomuntiy, sadiyadanumatiy siva, daryaday sanumutatyityiyada variy sa̱jisintyi.
Samáriyaja̱mi̱ jarye jto̱jada jiryupiyadamu simuntiy. Sadiyadanumatiy sivantiy, sa̱ntyutya̱da variy jasiñi̱.

Satuudiyadanumatiñi̱, si̱ndadoda ji̱ta ni̱ja̱ta variy jasirya savatajo̱, bínuja̱ta jarye risa̱ju̱, sarayada ji̱ta variy rivasirya savatajo̱. Sama̱sadeda variy jicyavañunchani̱, sa̱tidye jto̱ta nijya̱nvay jto̱jomuni̱, su̱nu̱yada variy jasiñi̱.

Rata̱rimyusiy ji̱ta sasipyata̱dara criquiy, danu̱ju̱y jarimyuni̱ jnu̱tya̱da murichirya, sasa̱yada ji̱ta jti̱joja̱mi̱ra, su̱teda variy siva: Ya̱jnu̱tyani̱ musiyé̱chí̱; ra̱numatiy ta̱rya jiyuju̱ntiy, ra̱murichenunuvi̱ varirya jiryatiy rasu̱tye murichedoda ranchaju̱ ji.”
Sitaja̱doda Jesús variñi̱ niquejada datyi̱: “Jijechipiya̱jadamu, ¿mi̱ra jivye mu̱nvamyusiy vichadeda nu̱tyu jityuunu vichi̱ni̱, mi̱? jiryatiy sito̱jada paranu̱nuvay jomuju̱.”
Su̱mutya̱jada ji̱tani̱ Jesús: “Ni̱ni̱ ji̱ta jiryatiy sa̱ntyutya̱dani̱.” “Jo. Ye̱jiya, daryani̱ ya̱jvaajeya̱sara ti̱ta̱ju̱.”
Jesús jañu̱yada nadimu Mártabay, sataryatubay Maríyabatya
Jesúsveda jiya̱damu ji̱ta, sajañuvejada vicha̱da rapu̱ryademu; jasiy savicha̱da ti̱qui vatura, Márta jtyati̱bay, ni̱tiy diryejada jiryorimyuni̱ Jesús.
Savicha̱da ji̱ta sataryatuntiy, Maríya jtyati̱bay, ni̱tiy ma̱sa̱da sanumututuunu Jesús, satuva̱chunu̱yada rana̱cho̱ saniquejada jasiy.

Mártabay ji̱ta jaryuvu̱yada Jesús potyadedivayu. Mityamusiy satuudiyada ji̱tani̱ Jesús, su̱teda ji̱ta variy siva: “¿Ne yitaryu̱y nta tara variy, jiryatiy ratyeryatu tochiy ra̱siquita ray, jiryatiy ravyichaniy samirya jiyu day ji, Nutyityu̱? Ya̱jtay variy siva sa̱tidye jmu̱tya ray.”
Su̱mutya̱jada ji̱ta Nutyityu̱ ni̱: “Márta, Márta, jaryi jijechipityaja̱ra tara jvaayada, jipyaru̱tyanuma dyetya riva rajuura jvaayada ji.
Vinu rani̱ taraqui va̱tasara. Jityeryatu Maríya jaryeta̱sirya samirya jiyaru̱rya, jiryatimyu̱ ne ra̱so̱vachara simusiñu̱darya.”
